gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: He atahanga nui, he GIF, he ataata rānei me tētahi upoko me te kuputuhi ki runga, ka whakanohoia ki hea rānei o te whārangi.

configure.title: Atahanga, ataata rānei
configure.description: He kōnae JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM rānei.

configure.title: Kuputuhi kē
configure.description: Whakaahuatia te atahanga. Waiho kia wātea mēnā he whakapaipai noa iho.

configure.title: Upoko
configure.description: Te upoko ka whakaaturia ki runga i te pāpāho. Waiho kia wātea mēnā kāore.

configure.title: Kuputuhi
configure.description: Te kuputuhi ka whakaaturia i raro i te upoko, ki runga i te pāpāho.

configure.title: Whānui katoa
configure.description: Toro atu mai i te tapa ki te tapa, kaua e noho ki te tīwae ihirangi.

configure.title: Tāpare
configure.description: Te āhua o te noho a te whakaahua i ia rahi mata

advanced.title: Memeha
advanced.description: He tae ka whakatakotoria ki runga i te pāpāho. Mēnā he upoko, he kuputuhi rānei, ka noho tonu he tae, kia māmā tonu te pānui i te kuputuhi.

advanced.title: Pūwāhi arotahi whakapae
advanced.description: Te wāhanga o te atahanga ka noho kitea ina kokotia, mai i te 0 (mauī) ki te 100 (matau).

advanced.title: Pūwāhi arotahi whakararo
advanced.description: Te wāhanga o te atahanga ka noho kitea ina kokotia, mai i te 0 (runga) ki te 100 (raro).
